tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ri khrod ma'i cho ga'i zur 'debs byin rlabs chu rgyun spel pa'i gangs ri bzhugs so// swa sti/ ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i cho ga'i khrigs chags kyi rim par/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i gnas su stegs mtho zhing yangs par ras dkar dang stan khebs sogs gzhi gtsang ma dri nog med pa'i steng du nas 'bras gro sogs 'bru dngos gtsang lhad med bkram pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po'i steng du mañji bum pa bkod pa'i khar rin po che'i phor pa shing 'bras gtsang mas bkang ba'i dbus su mchod rten gyi bre la gzungs thag btags pa bzhag bum pa'i rgyab tu ri khrod ma sngon mo'i thang sku cod pan can rang la zhal phyogs par bkram/ de'i steng du gdugs me tog gi phreng ba can phub/ mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod g.yas bskor mtshams 'dzin dang bcas pa bshams/ de'i mtha' spos mi zan brgya mchod tsam 'grub kyang mchog tu legs/ de'i mtha' bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid sna bdun 'dod yon sna lnga sogs kyi tsakli yod na'ang 'khor mor bkram/ gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs dngos su yod na'ang btsugs pa'i shar du li ma yin pa gser dngul zangs lcags la sogs pa'i snod dam/ ye ma 'byor na rdza sder rdo g.yam sogs kyi steng du gtso mo'i gtor ma khru gang tsam zlum po/ pad 'dab bzhi bskor zhing rtse brgyad dang lte ba sogs mar rgyan sna tshogs kyis nor bu dang shing 'bras me tog lo ma sogs kyi ri mo mdzes tshon du ma dang / sgor rgyan ci mdzes kyis brgyan pa'i mthar sman dang dkar gsum mngar gsum phung por spungs pa la smyug ma gtsang ma'i ku sha la brten pa'i gtor gdugs phub/ de bzhin du 'og nas 'byung ba'i gtor ma rnams kyang snod so sor che chung mtho gang tsam dkar gtor rnams zlum gtor pad+ma'i snying po can pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba dang / dmar gtor rnams pad+ma nas rtse bar byin gyis phrar song zhing zur rtse mi rno ba la mdun du theb kyu thod gzugs can/

gtor ma de thams cad la rtse dang dkyil du sgor rgyan re/ 'byor na thams cad la gtor gdugs dkar po bcas gzhung bzhin la/ bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis phyir btang na legs pas drug pa dmar gtor gyi rjes su dgu pa dkar gtor bsham zhing phyi rol gtor ma dkar dmar gnyis stegs la bshams la/ chu gtsang bran/ gu gul gyis bdug sbyar spos rengs bu phal cher la gla rtsi dang chang 'dres pas bya rgyud la mi rung / dpon slob rnams kyi drung du rdor dril/ 'thor nas/ rol sil/ rnga dung sogs dang / 'og tu dgos pa'i sbyong chas/ gu gul/ yungs dkar/ khrus long / sku phyis sogs yo byad gang dgos 'du bya'o/ /cho ga byed pa'i thog mar yan lag lnga'i khrus bya ba'am yang na gdong lag pa tsam bkru/ rab byung yin na chos gos dang snam sbyar gyon/ sgrub khang du bzhugs nas rten la kha phyogs par rang gi snying kha nas zhes sogs kyis tshogs zhing spyan drangs/ phung pos lcogs na tshigs bcad thams cad la phyag bya/ ma lcogs na bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar/ thal mo snying khar sbyar te phyag 'tshal lo dang 'dud ces na ma byung ba'i tshe lus dang mgo dud tsam re byas la phyag 'tshal gyi tshig dma' bas gdangs med par 'dur shur gang rung gis byas la/ bsngo ba rdzogs nas rang rang gi gral la 'khod sdig bshags dang gso sbyong blang / sngon 'gro gtor ma la gdangs dang dril gsil phyag len bzhin byed/ gtor ma phyir dor ba'i tshe rol mo drag dung sogs bgegs gtor la byed pa bzhin bya/ tshogs zhing gi mchod pa la mgor mtshan sngags dang mjug tu pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ kun la sbyar/ snying po nye snying shub bur ci rigs dang / rtsa sngags dang rdzas sngags nyer gcig 'ur 'don byas pa'i rjes su bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can sogs gsol gdab dang gdan bsdu/ mchod pa byin brlab bum bskyed bya/ phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad la dung dang rol mo rab gnas bzhin mchod pa'i tshigs bcad dang sngags gdangs phyag rgya bcas/

gzhung du mi gsal ba rgyal srid sna bdun/ yo ga ltar/ 'dod yon lnga rnams phul nas/ bcom dril byas la bstod pa gdangs sam 'dur gang rigs/ snying po stong / nye snying lnga brgya shud bur/ rtsa sngags phreng 'khor 'ur 'don byas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang nas stsal du gsol gyi bar bdag bskyed kyi mjug bzhin mchod pa byin brlab rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma'am bstod pa gong bzhin byas la sbyin sreg la 'jug rdzas rnams ril bu mthe'u chung gi mgo tsam byas nas phul na dri chung zhing 'gad gtsang / gtor ma'i mchod pa'i mthar mchod rol bcas la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig dril bu sum rdung dang bcas mchod sbyin gtor ma nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi mthar rol mo 'bud dkrol bya/ sbyin sreg dang 'di'i mchod sngags gdangs med pas/ gtor ma 'og ma rnams la gdangs ma byung kyang chog cing / rol mo thob mtshams dril gsil bya/ nad bdag dmar dkar gyi gtor ma phyir dor/ gzhi bdag gtor ma'i rjes su nad bdag dkar dmar gyi gtor ma mchod pa dang bcas dang rdor dril rol mo dung sogs khyer/ zhwa gyon/ grong khyer gyi phyi lam gyi bzhi mdo lta bur phyin la/ gtor ma dmar dkar a mṛ tas bsang ba sogs gtso gtor byin rlabs bzhin dang / cho ga gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin la dkar gtor rgyang ring du dor ba'i bar gyis bya/ de nas nang du log pa'i tshe rol mo'i sgra sogs ci yang mi dgos par log la gral la 'khod nas/ tad+ya thā/ tsa le zhes pa nas ma 'dug cig swāhā'i bar brjod/ de nas mjug cho ga bya'o/ /rang bdag gtor ma 'di dag yi ge sngon ma rnams nang du bya bar gsungs pa bzhin nged rang gi cho ga khrigs su'ang bris nas lag len de ltar byas pa yin kyang don la phyir gtang ba 'di legs shing 'gad gtsang bas slar 'di ltar bya'o/ /tshe drag rol drag dung byed/ mchod pa kha gsos/ bsang sbyang byin brlab/

mchod yon phal cher ma la/ bdag nyid chen mo lo ma gyon ma mchod/ ces sogs sbyar/ bstod pa/ thal mo sbyar nas nad zhi ba'i 'dod gsol rnams gdangs med par bya/ sgrub zhag ji ltar byed ring bsgrub khang gi rtse nas sbyar khrus byed/ grol nyin gzhi bdag gtor ma rdzogs par gtong / thog mar mchod phreng dang / rnga rol/ sku bris pa'i ba dan/ glegs bam/ gtso gtor/ sbyang chas/ khrus bum rnams mi re res gtsang sbra dang ldan pas khyer/ de'i rjes su gzungs chog byed mi dang / dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang / skye bo'i dmag mi shin tu mang ba bcas byas la/ thog mar sgrub pa po rnams sgrub khang du langs nas snying po'i sngags 'ur 'don lan gcig byas pa'i mthar/ slob dpon rang nyid bcom ldan 'das shākya thub dang / las kyi rdo rje 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ gzhan yang sgrub grogs rnams dang / dge 'dun gyi tshogs skye bo'i dmag dpung dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / phyogs skyong ba dang 'jig rten skyong ba'i rnam par gyur nas yul phyogs 'di'i nad gdon skrod cing yams zhi ba dang 'jig rten la phan gdags pa'i phyir gshegs so/ /zhes brjod pas rol mo'i bye brag kun bsgrags shing / thams cad gyis pi shā tsi dang sum+bha nas badz+ra satwa kro dha sogs 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi sngags dang / na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya sogs bgegs skrod kyi sngags dang / gzhan yang phyag rdor rta mgrin sogs khro bo'i sngags shes tshad bton la grong khyer yul ljongs bskor ba'i mthar/ lho phyogs sa gtsang zhing mtho bar me long chen mo phyar la yul gyi gzugs brnyan snang ba de la las kyi rdo rje kha phyogs pas gtor ma ting lo changs bu rnams bskor nas snod gcig tu gsag dpon slob rnams kyis zhi ba dang / zhi drag phyed ma dang / drag po'i sbyang ba rnams byas la bden bdar lan gsum gyi dang po rdzogs nas sbyong chas mi zhig la bskur/

chu gzhung thag shin tu ring bar skyel du btang ba rol mo drag sngags yungs dkar gyis brab/ dge 'dun rnams kyis bdud zlog skye bo rnams kyi go rdeb pa dang / ki 'don pa sogs de ltar lan gsum byas la grong khyer so sor steng 'og bar gsum la rdzas rig sngags can gyi dud pas bdug pa'i brda sbyar/ sdig pa sbyong ba'i til lan gsum ma yin par nyer gcig tsam gyi bar du bsreg 'di'i dmigs pa la mi'i 'gro ba kho na ma yin par sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib so sor sna sgo nas thon/ til la thim pas til 'bru re re bzhin kaṃ yig gi sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pa can gyi rnam par gyur pa de ye shes kyi me phung shin tu che ba dang / thugs rje'i chu rgyun rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil pa la btab pas gtsang sing gis dag pa'i dmigs pa bsgom/ me long gi nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba la khrus rnams byas nas phar phyin drug gi khrus mjug gi sh+lau ka gsum po so sor sngags dang bcas pa byas nas sku phyis/ rang gi snying ga nas zhes pa nas/ dgongs pa rtse gcig tu mdzad par gyur/ zhes dang / bi sa ra ta nas yams kyi nad rnams zhi bar gyur cig ces pa'i rjes su drag rol drag dung dang / slob dpon gyis rdor dril dang bcas pas bum chu phyogs thams cad du gtor/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre/ su mu sogs mang po 'dab nas brjod dgos rnams la mdzub mo so so la nyis bgrang dang tshig bgrad byas pas grangs mi 'khrul zhing 'don pa de/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag ni grub bo zhes pa'i rjes su gzhan rnams kyi gang la ser sna ma gdangs dang dril bsil byed/ slob dpon gyis pi shā tsi ci rigs brjod pa'i rjes su/ bum chu yul phyogs thams cad du gtor la shān+tiṃ ku ru'i spel tshig yod pa rnams grangs ci rigs brjod/ gang la ser sna dang slob dpon gyi 'don cha rnams rdzogs nas thal mo sbyar la/

nad gzhi tshigs bcad thung ngu rnams la bar gdangs dang / sa skya nad grol ma la rgyun gyi gdangs byas nas der gang yod pa khrus chu 'gyed/ bkra shis kyi tshig ji ltar rigs pa brjod rjes rol mo 'bud dkrol dang bcas pas tshang ma log la grong khyer lcags ris bskor zhing sgo bzhi yod pa lta bu yin na lho sgo'i thems pa la sgrub pa po rnams kyi rkang pa g.yas pa bzhag la 'di'i gzungs 'don/ bton tshar rjes kha rgyan la bcings pa'i gzungs kyi thum bu gcig sgo gong la btags/ de bzhin du nub byang / shar rnams su de ltar bya ba ni cung zhi ba dang / nad tshabs chen lho sgo nas shar/ byang nub tu bskor/ de ltar ma yin na yul de'i gtso che ba'i rgyal sgo la bya ba'am/ yang na sa yi mdud gcig tu mtshams gcod byas la gzungs sngags kyi thum bu lnga las/ bzhi yul gyi phyogs bzhir tho brtsigs pa'i nang du gzhug gcig dbus kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la 'dogs pa ni gong 'og kun la 'dra bas de ltar mtshams bcad pa'i rjes su/ dge 'dun skye bo sogs rang rang gi gnas su log sgrub pa po rnams yul de'i dbus mkhar gyi rtse mo la phyin te rgyal mtshan la gzungs gdags/ mchod bstod/ 'dod gsol/ gzungs 'don/ bkra shis sogs byas nas nang du log la mjug chog dkyus bzhin byas te las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /zhes ri khrod ma'i cho ga'i zur 'debs 'di'ang sa skya pa kun blos rang nyid kyis bsgrigs pa'i lo ma gyon ma'i cho ga byin rlabs rgyun gyi gsal byed du bris pa 'di la gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya pa'i phyag len rnams gtso bor 'khod song bas gzhan gyis nyams su len tshe gdangs dbyangs rol mo sogs ni rang rang gi bla ma gong ma'i phyag len bzhin bgyis pas don grub bo// //yi ge pa ni bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis pas dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
